round: # one row per forecast, sealed before the round's first job; rows starting # are notes, the scorer skips them; keep the column order (the scorer reads by position)
# R1: columns 1-8; p_beat_yardstick (name kept for the scorer) = p that the round passes all three parts of R1's pass rule, not p of beating the yardstick; *_net15 = lead15

# p start (R1, R3, R3P): a counted share, k of n rounds of the brief (BASE RATES) that met the parts of the pass rule the brief gives numbers for (margin over the same-side yardstick, t; say which part it cannot show), over a set you name (all rows of that round, same-side rows, or same-move rows); then adjust, with the reason; a normal approximation from your own lead15 and interval is an adjustment, never the start; a control run starts from the yardstick

# p note (every row with a p, R3P too; one shared line above the rows does not count): the note says what p is the probability of, with the rule's numbers, then the base: "p of lead15 >= <same-side yardstick + 2>, t >= 3, >= 3 of 5 months above <yardstick>; base k of n <set>; moved because <reason>"
# R2: one row per split reading: round R2, utc, reading, pred_better_state (high or low), pred_gap_t (signed: high minus low); columns 3-11 empty
# R3 and R3P: columns 1-8 (p = p of passing R1's rule, not R3's own rule; note as in "p note") plus gain_vs_r1 with its 80 pct interval, shrunk toward the MOVES mean
# no placebo: one R3P row with round and utc, numbers empty, note "not run: no placebo"
